pose_configuration.nail_shape: Two opposite circular arcs, followed by a flat terminal. Developed arc length is preserved; the sensing body remains on its original plane.
pose_configuration.tpu_shape: Retain the source curvature across the side tab. Stiffener pieces require separate forming/cut-pattern review.
limits: Nominal geometry only; actual forming, copper/via strain, adhesive and repeated-motion behavior require bench tests.
The 4 mm terminal stiffener lies after the bent free section. No bend is intentionally placed through its plated transition.

source_hard_conversion.scope: Faceted recovery of the pinned STL, not the original author's analytic CAD or a physical fit measurement.

limits: Nominal shaped nail tails and conforming TPU side tabs; cable slack and moving-source behavior remain.
Known same-cell layers use disjoint material domains or thickness intervals in an injective chart; source and other-cell comparisons use native solids.
Common curve samples closer than 0.00001 mm are consolidated to avoid duplicate CAD vertices.
Solder and stiffener envelopes must clear the complete source finger and every other cell stack.
Curved stiffener fabrication and strain at the plated transition are not qualified by a geometric fit check.
